# A Game About Digging A Hole - LLMs Guide

A Game About Digging A Hole is a minimalist adventure game where players dig deep beneath a newly purchased house to collect resources, upgrade equipment, and uncover a mysterious secret. Play online or get it on Steam!

## Primary Pages & URLs
- Homepage: https://agameaboutdiggingahole.net/
- About Us: https://agameaboutdiggingahole.net/about-us
